title: Compact density empty states for fixed-height dashboard tab cards
answers: Empty state text/CTA gets cut off or overflows the Dashboards card
How to add an empty state that fits a short scroll area
EmptyState component too tall for the redesigned homepage card
body:
Symptom: a tab's empty state (message + description + button) overflows or clips inside the Dashboards/Alerts card's fixed-height scroll area on the redesigned homepage.
Root cause: the full @grafana/ui EmptyState (image, padding, description paragraph) is taller than the fixed DASHBOARD_TABS_SCROLL_HEIGHT_REDESIGN area.
Fix pattern: use DashboardTabEmptyState with density='compact', which drops the image and description and renders just the message text + optional button; pass density from the tab component's useFlagGrafanaGrowthHomepage() check.
Constraints: only for cards/tabs rendered inside a fixed, short scroll container on the redesigned homepage; the default (non-compact) density still uses the full EmptyState elsewhere.

search: Empty states in fixed-height dashboard tab cards on the redesigned homepage must use DashboardTabEmptyState with density='compact' to avoid overflow or clipping within the DASHBOARD_TABS_SCROLL_HEIGHT_REDESIGN container. Compact density drops the image and full description, rendering only the message text and optional button. This applies to public/app/features/home/DashboardTabs/*Tab.tsx empty states (e.g., RecentDashboardsTab.tsx) when useFlagGrafanaGrowthHomepage() is true; the default density remains standard elsewhere.
